experiments.recommendation: A: Paired portraits keeps the person as the hero while adding the mutual "you and them" meaning, with no new feature. B is a safe fallback if photo recognisability matters most; C is best kept for empty states.

Current.name: Frozen checkpoint
Current.rationale: The pre-run candidate, exactly as tagged. A, B and C are built on the refined candidate, so they also carry this run's baseline corrections (V3-D01, V3-D02, V3-F01); open "Refined control" below to see the same layout with only those corrections.

A.name: Paired portraits
A.rationale: Axis: relationship: both people as two tilted portrait cards with a heart on the seam; headline names both. Says "the two of you" without words; familiar from Bumble. Costs: shows your own photo too (placeholder-heavy until real photos exist) and two cards are smaller than one.

B.name: Identity-led photo hero
B.rationale: Axis: scale and immersion: the person's photo fills 54% of the height with name, age and verification on it, as on their Discover card. Most recognisable: the match looks exactly like the card you liked. Costs: the photo dominates, the moment reads like a profile, and shared interests drop below the fold on short phones.

C.name: Restrained cat celebration
C.rationale: Axis: emotional tone through illustration: the celebrating cat leads; small round avatars and shared interests in one card. Warmest and lightest; the cat never covers a face. Costs: people are small, so the identity is weaker; the cat may feel playful for some users.

experiments.recommendation: Current: UI-042 is an approved review decision and the refined header already meets it. If you want change, C is the closest to UI-042 and adds one-tap Preview.

Current.name: Frozen checkpoint
Current.rationale: The pre-run candidate, exactly as tagged. A, B and C are built on the refined candidate, so they also carry this run's baseline corrections (V3-D01, V3-D02, V3-F01); open "Refined control" below to see the same layout with only those corrections.

A.name: Photo-led cover
A.rationale: Axis: photo emphasis: a wide cover photo with the name on it and Edit as a white pill. Shows how others first see you. Costs: departs from the approved UI-042 round photo; weak with no photo (initial on grey).

B.name: Compact identity row
B.rationale: Axis: density: 72pt photo beside name and verification, Edit as a small button; profile rows move up a third of a screen. Most efficient; everything important above the fold. Costs: less personal, departs from UI-042.

C.name: Identity with quick actions
C.rationale: Axis: action access: centred photo with an edit badge, then Edit, Preview and Verify as three equal actions. Keeps UI-042's centred round photo and adds Preview one tap away. Costs: Edit loses its full-width primary button; three tiles add visual weight.

Current.name: Frozen checkpoint
Current.rationale: The pre-run candidate, exactly as tagged. A, B and C are built on the refined candidate, so they also carry this run's baseline corrections (V3-D01, V3-D02, V3-F01); open "Refined control" below to see the same layout with only those corrections.

A.name: Cat says hello
A.rationale: Axis: character: the waving cat replaces the generic drawing; Discover plus a quieter Events path in the same card. Friendly and still contained in Ente's EmptyState card; adds a second real route. Costs: two buttons in an empty state.

B.name: Next steps list
B.rationale: Axis: actionable choices over mood: no art, short explanation, then Discover, Likes (when there are any) and Events as one list card. Most useful for someone who wants to act now; shows the real Likes count. Costs: no warmth; reads like a menu.

C.name: Open page, one action
C.rationale: Axis: page-level editorial composition: no card; left-aligned cat, large title, one pill-width primary. Calm and confident, like Bumble. Costs: a lot of open page; a single action.

A.name: Ente progress banner
A.rationale: Axis: the number leads: muted label, large percentage, round arrow, bar; the whole card opens the hub (Ente banner). Directly from the Ente source; removes a second purple button. Costs: the action is an arrow, less explicit than a labelled button.

B.name: Next single task
B.rationale: Axis: specificity: names the next unfinished part with its count; Continue opens that editor; See all opens the hub. Most actionable; one tap to the exact editor. Costs: more text; Bio opens the hub because its editor is a sheet there.

C.name: Cat encouragement
C.rationale: Axis: warmth through illustration: the cheering cat beside the existing title, bar and action (optional UI-043 idea). Encouraging, small, and reuses the approved cat. Costs: one more illustration on a busy tab.
